name: Men men
summary: Mèn mén is the Mong corn staple: dried corn milled on stone, sieved, and steamed twice. Chew it slowly and it turns nutty, sweet, and full-flavored.
origin: Mong highland kitchens, made from corn.
howToEat: Eat it with thắng cố and a cup of corn wine, the highland pairing.
where: Mong home cooking across the northwest highlands, from Sa Pa to the Hà Giang plateau.
seoTitle: Men men in Sapa — Mong steamed corn
seoDescription: Mèn mén is the Mong corn staple, stone-milled and steamed twice, nutty and sweet when chewed slowly, and eaten with thắng cố.
